briefdescription.para: M2::ARingRRR arbitrary-precision real numbers backed by MPFR.

detaileddescription.para: ARingRRR is the precision-flexible sibling of ARingRR. Each instance carries a mPrecision mantissa bit count (returned by get_precision()) and stores each element as a __mpfr_struct of that precision; instances of different precisions are treated as distinct rings, so 53-bit and 100-bit values cannot silently mix. Every arithmetic operation routes through MPFR the actively-used surface is mpfr_add / _sub / _mul / _div / _neg / _fma / _pow_si / _pow_z / _si_div plus the comparisons mpfr_cmp / _cmp_si / _cmpabs, the setters mpfr_set / _set_d / _set_q / _set_si / _set_z / _get_d, and the lifecycle pair mpfr_clear / _swap all under round-to-nearest-ties-even (MPFR_RNDN). Transcendentals (mpfr_sin, mpfr_log, etc.) are not called from this class; alternative rounding modes are not exposed either.

The header pulls in interface/gmp-util.h for moveTo_gmpRR, which migrates the MPFR mantissa onto the GC heap when returning a value to the interpreter, and interface/random.h for randomMpfr (uniformly distributed mpfr_t at the ring's precision). IM2_Ring_RRR(prec) in interface/ring.cpp is the M2-side factory: it returns ConcreteRing<ARingRR> when prec <= 53 and ConcreteRing<ARingRRR>(prec) otherwise.
